parameters.query:
-- Idempotent save: one row per candidate+job (record_key is the primary key).
-- Saving the same match again updates the row instead of duplicating it,
-- and RETURNING reads back what earlier runs stored (times_saved, first_saved).
INSERT INTO bait_recommendations
  (record_key, candidate_id, candidate_name, job_id, job_title, company, score, reason, last_checked)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, now())
ON CONFLICT (record_key) DO UPDATE SET
  candidate_name = EXCLUDED.candidate_name,
  job_title      = EXCLUDED.job_title,
  company        = EXCLUDED.company,
  score          = EXCLUDED.score,
  reason         = EXCLUDED.reason,
  last_checked   = now(),
  times_saved    = bait_recommendations.times_saved + 1
RETURNING record_key, score, times_saved, first_saved, last_checked;
